title: Marguerite and the Witness
author: Mirabel Dravenmoor
blurb: Orsen Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
